film: THE GAP V1.1: first real 10 s production (story-only reference: why railroads leave gaps; original design)

s01_start.rationale: Mara fills the frame and owns the eye; the open joint is only a defocused break in the grey rail band along the bottom, so muted it reads as 'woman on a track', not 'look at this gap'. Left arm cut by the frame edge, arms float in a hanger pose, feet hidden behind the near rail with no contact shadow; generic red hut behind.
s01_start.fix: Drop the camera to rail-head height 0.6 m in front of the joint and focus on it, so the two polished rail ends and the dark 19 cm hole sit sharp in the lower third (>=40 px wide at 720), with Mara smaller behind it, bent over it, one hand pointing into the gap and soles planted with a contact shadow on the ballast.

s01_end.rationale: The wink and sly smile on 'gaps?' are a clear, specific beat change, but the question noun is still not the focus: the gap is blurred and partly behind her legs, and the caption lands on her vest.
s01_end.fix: On 'gaps?' have her point down into the joint (hand ending at the rail end) and rack focus from her face to the gap; keep the caption over plain ballast, not over the vest.

s02_start.rationale: The two lines under a bright sun and a tiny Mara are readable as a place, but heat is not: the 'tired' face with a zZ glyph reads as sleepy, no shimmer is visible, and the left line's joints are not visible at this distance, so 'ours has gaps, that one doesn't' does not read. Nothing shows steel growing.
s02_start.fix: Replace the zZ with big sweat drops and a wilting pose, add visible heat-shimmer distortion over both rails, and push a short insert of a rail end creeping forward (with a red-orange glow) so 'steel grows' is shown, not said.

s02_end.rationale: Practically identical to s02_start: same framing, same pose, same face; the warm wash is too faint to register, so the station adds no new information on 'heat'.
s02_end.fix: Make the 'heat' landing visible: hard warm wash plus a glint flaring along the bright rail and Mara fanning herself with her hat, or cut the rest and let the camera keep travelling.

s03_start.rationale: Good choice of view: low along the bright unbroken line with the jointed line beside it, and the first bow is visible. But the bright rail is a flat white extruded bar with a sawtooth top edge, has no tie plates and hovers over the sleepers, so it looks like a render glitch rather than steel under compression.
s03_start.fix: Give the perfect line a real rail profile and tie plates on every sleeper like line A, kill the sawtooth edge artifact, and add tiny compression arrows or squash lines at both far ends so 'pushes' reads before the bow.

s03_end.rationale: The strongest panel: the sideways S reads at a glance and the dust puff marks the snap. But in the live set the rails slide over static, straight sleepers (they are not dragged or twisted), faint ghost lines trail across the ties, and no ballast is shoved out, so the physical violence of the buckle is missing.
s03_end.fix: Make the sleepers move with the rails (rotate and shift them under the S, as the prop_track_buckled asset does), throw ballast out on the outside of each bend, remove the ghost-line artifact, and add a bigger dust burst plus a 2-frame camera kick on 'snaps'.

s04_start.rationale: A hard cut back to the opening frame with a proud face, but the answer object (the gap) is again a blurred grey band behind her legs; muted, the payoff reads as 'she is pleased', not 'the gap is why'.
s04_start.fix: Open the last shot on the gap itself, sharp and centred in the lower third, with Mara crouched beside it tapping the rail end; only then reveal her proud face.

s04_end.rationale: The 'room' growth is a small orange block that pops out of the rail end and reads like a floating flag or texture glitch, half lost at the bottom edge and in defocus; it is not clear the steel grew and still has room left, so the film's answer is not shown. Smug blush face is fine.
s04_end.fix: Show the growth as the rail end itself sliding 60% across the gap with a red-hot glow, stopping with a clearly visible dark gap left, framed sharp mid-frame with a small 'still room' bracket or Mara's thumb-and-finger gesture measuring it.

char_mara.rationale: On model and consistent across front, 3/4, side, back and the cards; the hi-vis vest, straw hat with rose band and ponytail fit the track-keeper role and read at phone size; expressions sus/proud/smug are distinct. But the lean_in pose has a detached-looking back arm and a coat-hanger front arm and actually leans away, the 'tired' face reads as sleepy, and in-film she is repeatedly cut by the frame edge with no foot contact.
char_mara.fix: Rebuild lean_in as a real lean toward the joint (hips back, chest over the gap, one hand on the knee, one pointing down), swap the tired zZ glyph for sweat drops, and keep the whole figure inside the frame with a contact shadow at the soles.

asset_prop_rail_joint_gapped.rationale: Preview matches the requirement on parts (dark sleepers, tie plates, fishplates with bolts, no sleeper under the joint, darker steel) and the identity is right, but the gap still reads small relative to gauge, the 'polished end faces' are barely brighter than the rail, sleepers are plain boxes; in the film it sits in the defocused foreground and never becomes the focal point.
asset_prop_rail_joint_gapped.fix: Make the end faces clearly bright polished steel (mat:metal.d4d9de with a hot specular), widen the visual gap or darken the void under it to near-black ballast, add bevels/grain to sleepers, and stage it in the focus plane in shots 1 and 4.

asset_prop_track_buckled.rationale: Preview reads as a sideways S with sleepers dragged and twisted and bright new steel, matching the requirement, but the ballast heaps are flat untextured pyramids and the sleepers plain boxes; in the film the visible buckle is the live set deformation where the sleepers do not move, so the asset's best story detail (dragged sleepers, shoved ballast) is not what the viewer sees.
asset_prop_track_buckled.fix: Swap in (or match) the asset's dragged-sleeper geometry at the end of the live buckle, give the ballast heaps gravel texture and scattered stones, and frame the settled kink against plain grass as the look bible asks.

film_level.notes: Sound-off chain: heat reads weakly (sun yes, shimmer/sweat no; the face reads sleepy), 'steel grows' is never shown, 'nowhere to go' is implied by the unbroken bright line, the sideways buckle reads (best beat), and the gap as the room it needs does not read in the payoff (orange block looks like a glitch). Hook: frame 1 shows Mara, not the strange object; the gap is a blurred band at the bottom, so the hook question is carried by the caption only. Shots 1 and 4 are the same framing with the hero cut by the left edge and no contact shadow; s02 start/end are identical. Environment is clean but generic toon (box sleepers, plain hut, flat rail bar with sawtooth artifact, ghost lines over the buckle). Camera idea 'down the other line' is visible and works. Not publishable yet. Note: the animatic.mp4 on disk hashes to eb71a4e88cb063b08bf21373b23454ce4adc6cb9, not the brief's 2c02c9b4...; I judged the file on disk.

studio_director.note: BACK to camera-director/props-hero/animator: re-stage shots 1 and 4 around a sharp, focal gap (and a readable rail-end growth that stops short), show expansion and heat in shot 2, and make sleepers move with the live buckle in shot 3; character-artist to fix the lean_in pose and tired face. Every panel is below 8.5; strongest is s03_end at 6.5.
